[SWS_DM_01073] DM behavior for subfunction ’defineByIdentifier’
⌈
On
reception of service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction ’defineByIdenti-
fier’ the DM shall activate this new DID and append the associated information received
from the diagnostic request: DID source, position and size.
⌋
